svg.text: The sigil carries identity and small expression. A brief head flash conveys what the mask cannot. At rest there is nothing. Three-quarter, calm colour, mask tone per fighter.
Working labels, placeholder looks. Status: proposal, pending Legal review.
The four fighters at rest, showcase size, three-quarter. No flash: the fight area is clean
Mask tone per fighter (approved by Orb)
Earnest, open, approachable. A pale mask is a small beacon
over the dark tunic at 40 px.
Guarded and formal: the face is a closed front. The emissive
sigil cracks with the facade. Dark reads well against sky.
Image-focused and theatrical: a polished bone mask, warm not
white. No horns, and the rest of her is dark olive.
A machine wearing politeness: a dark display face with a lit
sigil grid. It is the polite menace, and a lit screen is its
Gameplay size: 40 px and 12 px with a civilian, a "found" flash and a rage flash at their peak
Expression: neutral, taunt, hurt, rage, triumph (the sigil, the flash at its peak, and a head close-up)
Kept: the value rule, the two-tone edge, the far beacon, calm harmonious colour, three-quarter staging, and no borrowed look (designed masks, never grey and round, no cross-mark or dot eyes).
